Package com.j3d.ui.theme

Enum Class J3DTheme

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<J3DTheme>
com.j3d.ui.theme.J3DTheme
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<J3DTheme>, Constable
public enum J3DTheme extends Enum<J3DTheme>
The Main Theme enum where all theme properties are accessed

Almost all UI classes use this for consistent theming so changing this will just mean death.

Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
